sections.title: The Concept: Beyond Single Variables
sections.content: Introduce PDEs by contrasting them with Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs). Use a visual of a moving car (ODE - position changes with time) versus a vibrating drum membrane (PDE - position changes with time AND spatial coordinates x, y).
sections.example: A single fly moving in a line (ODE) vs. a ripple spreading across a pond (PDE).

sections.title: The 'Snapshot' Visualization: Partial Derivatives
sections.content: Explain partial derivatives visually using a 3D surface map. Show how keeping 'y' constant while varying 'x' results in a 2D slice (the partial derivative). Use color-coded gradients to show slopes in different directions.
sections.example: A cat walking across a hilly landscape; its change in elevation depends on whether it moves East-West or North-South.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: A Core Example
sections.content: Introduce the Heat Equation: u_t = α * u_{xx}. Use an animation showing a metal rod heating up. Explain that u_t (time rate) is proportional to the 'curvature' (u_{xx}) of the temperature profile—heat flows from hot spots to cold spots.
sections.example: A smart phone battery heating up while gaming; the heat diffuses outward from the processor core.

sections.title: Boundary Conditions: The 'Rules' of the System
sections.content: Explain that PDEs need constraints to have unique solutions. Use a visual of a guitar string tied at both ends (Dirichlet conditions) vs. a free-hanging rope (Neumann conditions).
sections.example: Defining that a guitar string must have zero displacement at both anchored ends to produce a musical note.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Impact
sections.content: Recap how PDEs model complex systems by relating rates of change across multiple dimensions. Conclude with a montage of applications: weather forecasting, fluid dynamics, and stock market modeling.
sections.example: Simulating how a shark's scent trail diffuses through the ocean current to reach a predator.

storyboard.title: The Concept: Beyond Single Variables
lecture_lines: ODE: One fly moving in a line.
PDE: Ripples spreading across a pond.
PDEs track changes in multiple dimensions.
animations: Create a Dot #FFFFFF at the center, representing a single point.
Transform the Dot into a 3D Surface #00FF00 to show multi-variable scope.
Highlight the Z-axis #FF00FF to represent the dependent output.
Animate a cross-section slice #FFFF00 passing through the surface.
Label the cross-section with MathTex 'f(x, y_0)' in white.

storyboard.title: The 'Snapshot' Visualization: Partial Derivatives
lecture_lines: A cat walking across hilly terrain.
Elevation change depends on movement direction.
animations: Create a 3D Surface #00FF00 representing a function f(x, y).
Draw a plane #FF00FF cutting through the surface at y=y_0.
Highlight the curve #FFFF00 formed at the intersection.

storyboard.title: The Heat Equation: A Core Example
lecture_lines: The heat equation models temperature diffusion.
Temperature change relates to spatial curvature.
Heat flows from hot to cold regions.
animations: Display the heat equation formula 'u_t = alpha * u_{xx}' in white.
Animate a heat map gradient from #FF0000 (hot) to #0000FF (cold).
Show the heat diffusing over a rod using a ColorBlend effect.

storyboard.title: Boundary Conditions: The 'Rules' of the System
lecture_lines: Guitar strings fixed at both ends.
animations: Draw a line segment #FFFFFF representing the spatial domain.
Place 'u(0, t) = 0' and 'u(L, t) = 0' labels at endpoints.
Animate the endpoints flashing #FF0000 to indicate fixed boundaries.

storyboard.title: Summary and Real-World Impact
lecture_lines: Nature unfolds through these dynamic equations.
animations: Display a collage of real-world thermal images.
Show the text 'PDEs govern complex physical systems' in white.
